assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a reusable small empty-workspace illustration for a personal CMDB web application, on a genuinely transparent background. Subject: a compact miniature architectural assembly of three abstract resource modules — a low server block with precise slots, a short storage cylinder, and a standing circular domain ring — neatly fitted into a shallow modular organizing tray, with two fine violet connection bridges. Style/medium: refined architectural paper-and-ceramic maquette, precise isometric geometry, crisp silhouette, subtle tactile matte surfaces, restrained editorial product illustration. Composition: a single cohesive centered cluster, three-quarter isometric view, plenty of transparent padding, all objects fully visible, readable at 180 CSS pixels, square canvas. Color palette: cool ivory modules, graphite dark sides, a limited indigo-violet #6C5CE7 accent; calm enough for a near-black #0A0A0B app shell. Constraints: actual alpha transparency; no text, numbers, logos, UI panels, frames, people, watermarks, ground plane, checkerboard, stars, neon, glassmorphism or glossy toy surfaces. This is a conceptual illustration, not a real network diagram.
